findings.description: The former registry described generic source-to-asset mappings as native codecs.
findings.data_impact: Most records only had immutable AssetVersion materialization.
findings.evidence: Registry now declares materialization_level, adapter, validator, projection, and activation strategies; 18 of 59 types are DOMAIN_NATIVE and 41 are ARCHIVAL_NATIVE.
findings.planned_fix: Implemented code-level evidence levels and closed registry.
findings.test_requirement: codec registry and migration level unit tests

findings.description: Validation and qualification names were declarative strings rather than domain execution.
findings.runtime_impact: Asset import could be mistaken for domain admission.
findings.data_impact: No projection or aggregate invariant proof for generic mappings.
findings.evidence: Core adapters invoke Book/BookDesign, StoryDesign, Planning, Source, and MKAOS authorities; other mappings remain archival by declaration.
findings.planned_fix: Keep unsupported domain types archival until a typed authority adapter exists.

findings.description: Legacy references were counted but not bound to target AssetVersions or projections.
findings.runtime_impact: Downstream relationship traversal could be incomplete.
findings.data_impact: Business-key relationships could be lost or ambiguous.
findings.evidence: 0058 adds stable two-pass reference rows and fail-closed resolution states; the service persists target item, asset, version, projection, and relation.
findings.test_requirement: two-pass, replay, missing, ambiguous, and cross-scope tests

findings.description: Legacy self-declared approval could influence activation.
findings.runtime_impact: Untrusted source state could bypass Authority admission.
findings.data_impact: Imported records could become ACTIVE/ELIGIBLE without an independent decision.
findings.evidence: Legacy approval is evidence only; approve/reject records actor, reason, expected version, hashes, validation evidence, idempotency, Audit and Outbox before adapter activation.
findings.test_requirement: legacy self-approval rejection and explicit activation tests

findings.description: Documented phases lacked durable evidence and a resume CAS boundary.
findings.runtime_impact: Crash recovery could repeat the entire item.
findings.data_impact: Phase provenance and competing-worker protection were incomplete.
findings.evidence: 0058 persists phase/version/timestamps/attempt/hash/evidence/error/next phase; transitions use expected item version and checkpoint hashes include reference state.
findings.test_requirement: state machine, CAS conflict, crash resume, and checkpoint tests

findings.description: Verification was generic AssetVersion reconciliation only.
findings.runtime_impact: A missing or inconsistent domain projection could pass.
findings.data_impact: Uniqueness, version and binding defects could remain undetected.
findings.evidence: DOMAIN_NATIVE adapters reconcile their actual projections and the service verifies Audit/Outbox per operation.
findings.planned_fix: Core adapters implemented; remaining archival types deliberately report no domain proof.

findings.description: Compatibility classification relied too heavily on directory location and direct imports.
findings.runtime_impact: Dynamic or transitive Legacy paths could be missed.
findings.data_impact: Authority could accidentally read a Legacy workspace.
findings.evidence: AST graph covers imports, relative imports, static importlib calls, factories/routers through transitive modules, console/worker/API/probe entrypoints, and exact guard paths.
findings.planned_fix: Implemented static graph; runtime OS-level syscall tracing remains a future defense-in-depth option.
findings.test_requirement: transitive reachability and fail-closed runtime-path tests

findings.description: Standard commands referenced obsolete services and CLI arguments.
findings.runtime_impact: Operator and CI paths could fail before validating Authority.
findings.data_impact: No direct data mutation; release qualification was unreliable.
findings.evidence: Authority Make targets, explicit Legacy profile, parser-valid Docker CMD, SHA-bound CI steps and SHA-named artifacts are enforced by tests.
findings.planned_fix: Implemented locally; remote final-SHA Actions proof is pending push/run.
findings.test_requirement: Makefile/Dockerfile/CLI contract, YAML parse, Compose config

findings.description: Compose performs a full Content operation but only lifecycle checks for other worker groups.
findings.runtime_impact: Container readiness is not domain execution proof.
findings.data_impact: No evidence that all seven workers executed and recovered an owned operation in Compose.
findings.evidence: Per-domain PostgreSQL integration exists and Outbox/Maintenance execution was strengthened, but no seven-scenario independent Compose harness exists.
findings.planned_fix: Retain explicit partial status; add seven isolated Compose scenarios in a later slice.
findings.test_requirement: seven independent Compose E2E with identity and restart evidence

findings.description: Health projections contained placeholder activity and ambiguous completion counts.
findings.runtime_impact: Operators could see READY with stale or synthetic activity.
findings.data_impact: Operational projections did not identify actual attempts and leases.
findings.evidence: 0058 and observer logic persist real active operation/attempt/counts, heartbeat, batch versus operation counters, drain and database states from successful or failed DB work.

findings.description: The executor existed without an explicit production adoption boundary.
findings.runtime_impact: Callers might assume broad automatic retry safety.
findings.data_impact: A future caller could repeat non-idempotent effects.
findings.evidence: Policy is now opt-in only for pure-database, idempotent transactions with stable keys; default UnitOfWork does not retry whole transactions.
findings.planned_fix: Implemented strategy two with guarded explicit opt-in.

findings.description: Broad BaseException catches and unsafe SQLSTATE assumptions could replay unknown outcomes.
findings.runtime_impact: Shutdown signals or uncertain commits could be retried as business work.
findings.data_impact: External or domain side effects could be duplicated.
findings.evidence: Production catches use Exception; 40001/40P01 are the only safe class; 08007 requires reconciliation; 08P01 never retries; external effects are rejected.
findings.test_requirement: classification, signal, unknown-commit and effect-boundary tests

findings.description: The existing test only proved index availability with sequential scans disabled.
findings.runtime_impact: Planner regressions at representative scale could pass CI.
findings.data_impact: Polling and claim latency could degrade under load.
findings.evidence: Release job seeds 100k Operation/Outbox/AssetVersion/Migration rows and 10k Books, then checks JSON ANALYZE plans without disabling sequential scans.
findings.planned_fix: Implemented as a separate release qualification job.
